name: add_item_to_cart_by_ean
description: Adds a product to the authenticated user's cart on Carrefour France using the product EAN, a basket service ID, and a sub-basket type (e.g. drive click-and-collect). Also accepts a tracking context to indicate the page type and page ID from which the action was triggered. Returns updated cart totals and summary.

ean.description: The EAN (barcode) of the product to add to the cart.

basketServiceId.description: The basket service ID identifying the store/drive service to use (e.g. '0678-150-7052').

subBasketType.description: The sub-basket type, such as 'drive_clcv' for drive click-and-collect.

pageType.description: The page type for tracking purposes (e.g. 'moncompte', 'search', 'pdp').

pageId.description: The page ID for tracking purposes (e.g. 'moncompte', a product or category ID).
